description: Election Commission - Notice Under Section 66A (1) (a) Appointed Mr.Gama Athige Ariyadasa as a Member of the Balangoda Pradeshiya Sabha.
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Balangoda Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member's resignation and the subsequent nomination of a replacement under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. The content specifically deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including party nominations and declarations of elected members, which falls squarely under Elections Gazettes (Type 7).
